images.name: hero
images.prompt: A delightful 16-bit side-scrolling game hero: young smiling airborne courier riding a burgundy magic carpet with golden tassels, teal jacket and cream scarf streaming behind. Full side profile facing RIGHT. Entire rider and carpet within a 32x32 native pixel canvas, readable face, large clean color clusters, charming hand-drawn Mega Drive pixel art. One isolated character, no floor, no text, no shadow under sprite. Crisp deliberate single-pixel details, dark purple outlines, never pure black outlines. High-contrast gold trim. Not isometric, no realistic texture.

images.name: boss_scarab
images.prompt: Boss sprite for charming 16-bit flying-carpet sidescroller: BRASSWING, a giant clockwork scarab beetle airship facing LEFT. Elegant rounded brass shell, turquoise jewel eyes, two broad articulated wing shields, wind-turbine abdomen, warm gold rivets. Endearing but imposing silhouette. 64x64 native pixel art, single isolated complete boss, transparent background. Dark purple outlines, clean pixel clusters, decorative readable motifs, no text, no floor. Side view suitable for horizontal combat.

images.name: boss_serpent
images.prompt: Boss sprite for charming Arabian-storybook 16-bit sidescroller: RIBBON ORACLE, a magical flying serpent facing LEFT, graceful curved turquoise ribbon body, cream belly, warm brass jeweled head ornaments and huge expressive eyes. Coiled S-shaped body contained entirely within 64x64 native pixels. No wings, no ground, transparent background. Crisp pixel clusters, dark purple outlines, golden highlights, no gradients or dithering, intricate but readable Sega Mega Drive pixel art.

images.name: boss_lantern
images.prompt: Boss sprite for original Arabian-storybook flying-carpet sidescroller: LANTERN VIZIER, an imposing ornate floating brass lantern prison containing a teal storm spirit with bright eyes, curled smoke arms and a gold crown-like finial. Transparent background, dark purple outlines, chunky polished 16-bit pixel clusters, readable gold filigree and turquoise glass, no floor, no text, no blurry texture.

images.name: far1
images.prompt: Sunlit desert sky and distant domed city for a charming Arabian-storybook flying carpet game. Broad peach/golden sky, a few huge soft cream cloud silhouettes, hazy sand mountains and tiny domes along only the lowest 55 pixels. Open uncluttered sky through center. Distant slow parallax layer, seamless horizontal repeat: matching left and right edges. Side view, native 256x192 Sega Mega Drive pixel art, deliberate crisp pixel clusters, no noisy dithering, no foreground objects, no characters or words.

images.name: near1
images.prompt: ISOLATED SCENERY CUTOUT, one continuous row of golden sandstone bazaar rooftops and domes with turquoise awnings and a few palms. STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE ELEVATION like a horizontal platform game, no perspective street, no vanishing point, no ground road. All buildings sit on same horizontal baseline. Transparent empty sky above skyline, no sky painted anywhere. Native 256x96 Sega Mega Drive pixel art, beautiful dark-purple contours, warm gold highlights, charming decorative arches. Row fills bottom 70 pixels, left/right edges match for scrolling.
